  typealias Texts = Array<String>
  typealias SignedBytes = Array<Byte>
  val WORD: String <const> = <expr>

  annotation class Tags(val names: Texts = [], val chars: Array<Char> = [LETTER], val flags: Array<Boolean> = [false, true, false])
  annotation class Numbers(val i8: SignedBytes = [-128, 127], val i16: Array<Int16> = [-32768, 32767], val i32: Array<Int> = [-2147483648, 2147483647], val i64: Array<Long> = [-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807], val u8: Array<UByte> = [0u, 255u], val u16: Array<UInt16> = [65535u], val u32: Array<UInt> = [4294967295u], val u64: Array<ULong> = [18446744073709551615u], val floats: Array<Float> = [FLOAT, 1.000000059604644775390625, 1e-45], val doubles: Array<Double> = [DOUBLE, -0.0, 5e-324])
    @Tags(["same", WORD, "same"], chars = ['A', LETTER, '雪'])
    @Numbers

    @Tags
    field value: T
